hook: The Blackmar-Diemer trap that punishes passive pawn captures in under 8 moves
text: The Blackmar-Diemer trap that punishes passive pawn captures in under 8 moves White sacrifices the e-pawn for rapid open-file development. When Black greedily grabs on d4, White's bishop sacrifice on f7 tears off the king's shield. Speed chess rule: Lead in development is worth more than a single flank pawn in blitz.
